fields.JP: スキル攻撃向上のユ血液

独房探索を開始したが、
やはり一筋縄ではいかないようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems as if it won't be as
easy as expected to 
search the cells.
fields.EN:
It seems as if it won't be as
easy as expected to 
search the cells.

fields.JP: 拾ったメモ（磁力の栓抜き）

壁にはまった鉄の栓、
何かの力で引っ張れないだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
A metal piece stuck 
in the wall... I wonder if 
I can pull it out somehow...
fields.EN:
A metal piece stuck 
in the wall... I wonder if 
I can pull it out somehow...

fields.JP: ジェイルには衝撃を与えると爆散する木の実があるようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's a nut that 
explodes with impact.
fields.EN:
There's a nut that 
explodes with impact.

fields.JP: 拾ったメモ（穴の開いた床）

穴を塞ぐものがあれば、
先に進めそうなのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
I should be able to move onward 
if I can only find something to 
plug the hole with.
fields.EN:
I should be able to move onward 
if I can only find something to 
plug the hole with.

fields.JP:
金属の塊が道を塞いでいる。
塊を動かす力さえあれば
fields.LOCALIZED:
A huge mass of metal is
blocking the way. If only I
had something to move it with.
fields.EN:
A huge mass of metal is
blocking the way. If only I
had something to move it with.

fields.JP:
溝の先の宝箱、
何か別の方法で取れないだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
There has to be a way to
get the treasure beyond 
the rift...
fields.EN:
There has to be a way to
get the treasure beyond 
the rift...

fields.JP: 拾ったメモ（物が乗ると開く）
人や物が乗ることで扉が開くようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like the portal will
open when something is
on the gimmick.
fields.EN:
It looks like the portal will
open when something is
on the gimmick.

fields.JP: 噴き上がる炎を消すことはできないだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't there a way 
I can douse the flames?
fields.EN:
Isn't there a way 
I can douse the flames?

fields.JP: 拾ったメモ（アイスを置く扉）

この扉の色は
一体何に関係しているのだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there any meaning to
the portal's color?
fields.EN:
Is there any meaning to
the portal's color?

fields.JP:
向こう岸に渡りたいが、
飛び越えるのは難しそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to get across the
water, but it's too far to
jump...
fields.EN:
I want to get to the other side,
but it looks too far to jump.

fields.JP:
水が流れ続けて通れない、
水を止めれないだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to find a way to stop 
the flow to move onward...
fields.EN:
I have to find a way to stop 
the flow to move onward...

fields.JP: 拾ったメモ（対岸のレバー）

レバーが遠くて届かない、
何か長いものはないだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't reach the lever...
I need something long
that can reach it.
fields.EN:
I can't reach the lever...
I need something long
that can reach it.

fields.JP: 拾ったメモ（ぶら下がり）
長物があれば、可動装置に届くのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only I had something long 
to reach the device with...
fields.EN:
If only I had something long 
to reach the device with...

fields.JP:
この扉はとてもじゃないが
素手で開くことができない
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way 
I can open this door with 
my bare hands.
fields.EN:
There's no way 
I can open this door with 
my bare hands.

fields.JP:
火の上を通した物には、
一瞬にして火が点くようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anything that goes over the
fire will light up in an 
instant.
fields.EN:
Anything that goes over the
fire will light up in an 
instant.

fields.JP: 封印の札も火にはかなわないようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems the seal tags can't
withstand fire.
fields.EN:
It seems the seal tags can't
withstand fire.

fields.JP:
小さな鍵穴に、
普通の鍵を挿す方法はないだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
There has to be a way
of getting the key through
this tiny keyhole...
fields.EN:
There has to be a way
of getting the key through
this tiny keyhole...

fields.JP:
遠くを狙える道具があれば、
先に進めそうなのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think I could move forward
if I just had something that
could shoot from a distance...
fields.EN:
I think I could move forward
if I just had something that
could shoot from a distance...

fields.JP:
歩いていては、
どうしても扉が閉まってしまう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Walking seems to trigger the
shutoff of the portal.
fields.EN:
If I walk, the door always
closes before I can get through.

fields.JP:
凶暴な植物には、
必ず対になる心臓があるようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Vicious plants have a heart
somewhere that can be 
targeted.
fields.EN:
Vicious plants have a heart
somewhere that can be 
targeted.

fields.JP:
扉を通る際に無数の手に襲われた。
危険な扉だ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was attacked by numerous hands 
when going through...
fields.EN:
I was attacked by numerous hands 
when going through...

fields.JP:
取っ手を掴む為の
長い何かがあればいいのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only I had something long to 
grab the handle with...
fields.EN:
If only I had something long to 
grab the handle with...

fields.JP: この扉は５つの宝石が鍵となるようだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like 5 gems are
needed to open this portal.
fields.EN:
It looks like 5 gems are
needed to open this portal.

fields.JP:
素早く通り抜けることで、
足元が崩れずに済んだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Running through helped me get
across safely.
fields.EN:
Running through helped me get
across safely.

fields.JP: 拾ったメモ（トランポリン＋）

走りながら使用すると、
高い跳躍力が得られた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I discovered I can leap
better when used while running.
fields.EN:
I discovered I can leap
better when used while running.

fields.JP: 拾ったメモ（跳ね返し扉）

歩いて通ると、
大きな痛手を受けてしまった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Walking across was a bad move... 
That hurt a lot.
fields.EN:
Walking across was a bad move... 
That hurt a lot.

fields.JP:
ジェイルにある物質は、
鋭利な刃物で切れるようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Objects within the Jail
can be severed with a
sharp enough blade.
fields.EN:
Objects within the Jail
can be severed with a
sharp enough blade.

fields.JP:
扉の放電を止めるには、
供給源を断ち切るしかない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Need to stop whatever's
electrifying the portal...
fields.EN:
To stop the door's electrical discharge,
we have to cut off its power source.

fields.JP:
この溝を飛び越えるには、
規格外の跳躍力が必要だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to need something
that can help me leap
across this rift.
fields.EN:
I'm going to need something
that can help me leap
across this rift.

fields.JP:
スイッチで可視化できる、
透明の床を発見した
fields.LOCALIZED:
Suddenly a switch came on, and
I could see everything!
fields.EN:
I found an invisible floor that
can be made visible with a
switch.

fields.JP: 水泡の中に神秘的な物体を見ることができた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I saw something divine
inside the bubble.
fields.EN:
I saw a mysterious object
inside the bubble.

研究材料としては面白いものらしい

Jail. It can be found in
multiple forms.
fields.EN:

have different structures, making them
interesting research material.

ナイトメアくうかん（全体）
対象の血式少女の穢れを全回復する
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fully remove a Blood
Maiden's Corruption.
fields.EN:
Fully remove a Blood
Maiden's Corruption.

fields.JP:
パーティ全体の血式少女の
穢れを一定量回復する
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heal a (％) of all Blood
Maiden's Corruption.
fields.EN:
Reduce all Blood Maidens'
Corruption by a set amount.

fields.JP:
敵一体をナイトメアくうかんに
閉じ込める
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seal 1 enemy in the
Nightmare Zone.
fields.EN:
Seal 1 enemy in the
Nightmare Zone.

fields.JP:
敵全体をナイトメアくうかんに
閉じ込める
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seal all enemies in
the Nightmare Zone.
fields.EN:
Seal all enemies in
the Nightmare Zone.

fields.JP: 敵一体をなぐりつける

対象血式少女の
ブラッドスケルター化を解除する
fields.LOCALIZED:
Undo Blood Maiden's
Blood Skelter state.
fields.EN:
Undo Blood Maiden's
Blood Skelter state.

fields.JP:
攻撃重視の前衛職。
スキルの数は少ないが
ステータスが高くパーティの要。
fields.LOCALIZED:
An offense-oriented, front-
line job. The job doesn't offer much in
Skills, but is augmented well in stats.
fields.EN:
An offense-oriented, front-
line job. The job doesn't offer much in
Skills, but is augmented well in stats.

fields.JP:
防御スキルに特化した前衛職。
一人では決め手にかけるが
盾となることでその本領を発揮する。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A defense-oriented, front-line
job. A bit lacking in offense,
but great at being a shield.
fields.EN:
A defense-oriented, front-line
job. A bit lacking in offense,
but great at being a shield.

fields.JP:
スピード重視の攻撃特化職。
一撃の重さはそこそこだが
手数でその差を十二分に埋める。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A speed-oriented attacker.
Excels in inflicting damage by
numbers.
fields.EN:
A speed-oriented attacker.
Excels in inflicting damage by
numbers.

fields.JP:
攻撃は最大の防御を示す職業。
受けるダメージを物ともせず
攻めに特化した攻撃は秀逸。
fields.LOCALIZED:
An attacker that sacrifices
defense for power, allowing it
to deal massive damage.
fields.EN:
An attacker that sacrifices
defense for power, allowing it
to deal massive damage.

fields.JP:
出血攻撃を巧みに操る職業。
血に関する能力の回転率は
他の追随を許さない。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A job with the most proficient
command in wielding blood-
based abilities.
fields.EN:
A job skilled at using Bleed attacks.
Its blood-related abilities cycle faster
than any other.

fields.JP:
スキル特化の後衛職。
物理防御は低いが魔法による
敵一掃が期待できる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A skill-oriented, rear-line
job. Its powerful magic makes
up for its lower defense.
fields.EN:
A skill-oriented, rear-line
job. Its powerful magic makes
up for its lower defense.

fields.JP:
治癒スキルに特化した回復職。
ＨＰ回復、蘇生、状態異常解除と
回復面で力を発揮する。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A specialist in healing who
can restore HP, heal ailments,
and even revive allies.
fields.EN:
A specialist in healing who
can restore HP, heal ailments,
and even revive allies.

fields.JP:
味方の強化に特化した援護職。
豊富な効果を使い分け、
パーティを勝利に導く。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A job that specializes in
providing support to party
members through buffs.
fields.EN:
A job that specializes in
providing support to party
members through buffs.

fields.JP:
敵の弱体化に特化した援護職。
弱体化を兼ね備えたスキルで
多くの敵を翻弄する。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A job that specializes in
weakening enemies through
debuffs.
fields.EN:
A job that specializes in
weakening enemies through
debuffs.

fields.JP:
出血攻撃を巧みに操る職業。
血と攻撃を織り交ぜたスキルを使い
戦場を血の海とする。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A job that masterfully uses
blood-based attacks on the
battlefield.
fields.EN:
A job skilled at Bleed attacks.
It uses Skills combining blood and attacks
to turn the battlefield into a sea of blood.

fields.JP:
豊富なＨＰを持つ遠距離特化職。
後衛でもその力を発揮し、
レンジを活かした遠距離攻撃が特徴。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A long range attacker with an
abundance of SP, dealing
damage from a safe distance.
fields.EN:
A long-range specialist with abundant HP.
It shines even from the rear row, using
its range for long-distance attacks.

fields.JP:
命中率の高いスキルから
味方の強化、敵の弱体化を
兼ね備えた遠距離特化職。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A versatile, long-range job
with a high hit rate and
buff/debuff Skills.
fields.EN:
A versatile, long-range job
with a high hit rate and
buff/debuff Skills.

fields.JP:
手数の多さを兼ね備えた攻撃職。
常軌を逸したその素早さは
いかなる戦況にも頼りになる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
An attacker that deals damage
in battle with profound speed.
fields.EN:
An attacker that deals damage
in battle with profound speed.

fields.JP:
隠密行動に特化した攻撃職。
敵から身を潜め、放つ一撃は
高い威力を秘めている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
An attacker that moves in
stealth, unleashing powerful
attacks from the shadows.
fields.EN:
An attacker that moves in
stealth, unleashing powerful
attacks from the shadows.

fields.JP:
敵からモノを掠め取る盗賊職。
命中と回避に特化し、
戦闘をこなす力も十分に持つ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Hunters can steal items
from enemies, and have high
hit and evasion rates.
fields.EN:
Blood Hunters can steal items
from enemies, and have high
hit and evasion rates.

fields.JP:
状態異常スキルを持つ援護職。
ステータス上昇スキルを併せ持ち、
スキルの幅広さが特徴。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A support role that can 
inflict ailments onto enemies
and use buffs to help allies.
fields.EN:
A support role that can 
inflict ailments onto enemies
and use buffs to help allies.

fields.JP:
アイテムの扱いに長けた特殊職。
スキルとしてアイテムを使い、
あらゆる戦況で活躍する。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A specialist in using Skills 
and items to change the course
of battle.
fields.EN:
A specialist in using Skills 
and items to change the course
of battle.

fields.JP:
敵の情報を分析する特殊職。
倒した敵のスキルを自らの力とし、
様々な状況で扱える。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A specialist that can analyze
enemies and take on the skills
of those they defeat.
fields.EN:
A specialist that can analyze
enemies and take on the skills
of those they defeat.

fields.JP:
ジェイルを知り尽くす特殊職。
ジェイルボーナスに特化する能力で
より豊富な恩恵を導き出す。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A Jail specialist who utilizes
Jail Bonuses to bring a number
of benefits to the party.
fields.EN:
A Jail specialist who utilizes
Jail Bonuses to bring a number
of benefits to the party.

fields.JP:
血に関するスキルを持つ攻撃職。
強力な出血攻撃は
辺り一面を血に染める。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A job that experiments with
powerful blood-based Skills to
deal heavy damage to enemies.
fields.EN:
An attack job with blood-related Skills.
Its powerful Bleed attacks
stain the whole area with blood.

fields.JP:
スキル枠を多く持つ、
オールラウンドな万能職。
攻撃スキルと補助スキルを持つ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
An all-rounder with numerous
Skill slots. Can use attack
and support-based Skills.
fields.EN:
An all-rounder with numerous
Skill slots. Can use attack
and support-based Skills.

fields.JP:
味方の強化に特化した援護職。
その癒しの歌は、活力を与え、
様々な効果をもたらす。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A support role specializing in
buffs. Poets heal and support
allies through their songs.
fields.EN:
A support role specializing in
buffs. Poets heal and support
allies through their songs.

fields.JP:
敵の弱体化スキルと攻撃スキルを
併せ持つ万能職。
踊りに魅了された敵に命はない。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A versatile job that uses 
debuffs and attack Skills. Its
dance means imminent death.
fields.EN:
A versatile job that uses 
debuffs and attack Skills. Its
dance means imminent death.

fields.JP:
犠牲を伴う強力なスキルや
ランダムスキルを習得する特殊職。
その能力は凶と出るか吉と出るか。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A unique job with random, 
double-edged Skills. Its 
impact on battle is up to fate.
fields.EN:
A unique job with random, 
double-edged Skills. Its 
impact on battle is up to fate.

fields.JP:
血を浴びるほど力を発揮する特殊職。
血に魅了された者が放つ力は
言わずと知れている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A unique job that draws power
from enemies' blood to strike
with unimaginable strength.
fields.EN:
A unique job that draws power
from enemies' blood to strike
with unimaginable strength.

fields.JP:
力強く光輝く意思をもつ力の職。
様々な力で敵をなぎ倒していく
fields.LOCALIZED:
A job for those with a shining
will. Use a variety of powers
to bring down your enemies.
fields.EN:
A job for those with a shining
will. Use a variety of powers
to bring down your enemies.

fields.JP:
天の川の如く色々な技を繰り出す職。
様々なスキルで敵を翻弄する。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A job with as many skills
as the stars in the Milky
Way to bring down foes.
fields.EN:
A job with as many skills
as the stars in the Milky
Way to bring down foes.

fields.JP:
敵の急所を確実に付いていくことを
得意とする長距離職。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A job that specializes in
striking enemy weaknesses
from afar.
fields.EN:
A job that specializes in
striking enemy weaknesses
from afar.

fields.JP:
敵を分析し味方をフォローする職。
様々な打開策を見つける者として
役に立つ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A job that supports allies
by analyzing enemies, and
offering battle strategies.
fields.EN:
A job that supports allies
by analyzing enemies, and
offering battle strategies.

fields.JP:
様々な願いを身につけた職
全ての武器や様々なスキルで
その場に合った動きを魅せる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A job that weaves wishes
into reality. They can use
any weapon to their liking.
fields.EN:
A job that weaves wishes
into reality. They can use
any weapon to their liking.

fields.JP:
水族館跡エリアで暴れている
シザームーンを8体
討伐してきてくれ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you go and hunt
8 Scissor Moons at
the Aquarium Ruins?
fields.EN:
Can you go and hunt
8 Scissor Moons at
the Aquarium Ruins?

fields.JP:
連れが怪我してしまったんだ。
小型医療キットを
分けてくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you spare some
Small Med Kits
for my friend?
fields.EN:
Can you spare some
Small Med Kits
for my friend?

fields.JP:
棚が壊れちゃってさ。
木材を探してきてほしんだよね。
水族館跡エリアに落ちて無いかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need some wood, but
maybe there's some at
the Aquarium Ruins.
fields.EN:
My shelf broke, so I need some wood.
Could you look for some around
the Aquarium Ruins?

fields.JP:
ジェイルの性欲調査の為に
ジェイルの性欲を5回
満たしてきてほしい。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you please satisfy
the Jail's Libido 5 times
for research purposes?
fields.EN:
Can you please satisfy
the Jail's Libido 5 times
for research purposes?

fields.JP:
極小ドライバーが足りなくてね。
見つけたら、持ってきてほしいんだよね。
地下洞窟エリアとかにありそーじゃん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ya mind looking for a
Mini-Screwdriver at the
Underground Cavern?
fields.EN:
Ya mind looking for a
Mini-Screwdriver at the
Underground Cavern?

fields.JP:
元街道沿いエリア１区に居座ってる
ハーフラビットを
倒してきてくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you get rid of the
Wererabbit at the
City Streets Area 1?
fields.EN:
Can you get rid of the
Half Rabbit at the
City Streets Area 1?

fields.JP:
オレにも戦う術が欲しい。
クレイモアを
分けてくれないか。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to fight...
Can you get me a
Claymore?
fields.EN:
I want to fight...
Can you get me a
Claymore?

fields.JP:
旧学生街エリア4区に
豆袋を落としてきちゃったの。
お願い大事なものなの。見つけてきて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I lost my precious bag
of beans at the Dorm
Area 4! Please find it!
fields.EN:
I lost my precious bag
of beans at the Dorm
Area 4! Please find it!

fields.JP:
水族館跡エリアで暴れている
ネオナマリコを10体
討伐してきてくれ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you go and hunt
10 Neo Sea Cucumbers
at the Aquarium Ruins?
fields.EN:
Can you go and hunt
10 Neo Sea Cucumbers
at the Aquarium Ruins?

fields.JP:
旧学生街エリアで暴れている
ソウルメフィストを5体
討伐してきてくれ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you go and hunt
5 Soul Mephists at
the Dorm?
fields.EN:
Can you go and hunt
5 Soul Mephists at
the Dorm?

fields.JP:
ダメ元で申し訳ないのだが…、
元・解放地区まで行って、
探してきてほしいものがあるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I'm going to
ask something
unreasonable, but...
fields.EN:
Sorry to ask when it may be hopeless,
but there's something I want you to find
in the former Liberated District.

fields.JP:
ジェイルの食欲調査の為に
ジェイルの食欲を5回
満たしてきてほしい。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you please satisfy
the Jail's Hunger 5 times
for research purposes?
fields.EN:
Can you please satisfy
the Jail's Hunger 5 times
for research purposes?

fields.JP:
旧河川・沼エリアで暴れている
ブラックオクタロスを5体
討伐してきてくれ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you go and hunt
5 Black Octoros at
Waterside?
fields.EN:
Can you go and hunt
5 Black Octoros at
Waterside?

fields.JP:
拠点開拓の資材が足りないんだ。
旧寺院エリアのブルーダイス等から
刀の破片をあつめてきてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please gather Katana
Fragments from the
enemies at the Temple.
fields.EN:
Please gather Katana Fragments from Blue Dice
and other enemies at the Temple.

fields.JP:
孤児院の食料が尽きてしまったの。
ドライフルーツを
分けてくれないかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The orphanage ran out
of food... Can you spare
some Dried Fruits?
fields.EN:
The orphanage ran out
of food... Can you spare
some Dried Fruits?

fields.JP:
ジェイルの睡眠欲調査の為に
ジェイルの睡眠欲を1回
満たしてきてほしい。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you please satisfy
the Jail's Sleep once
for research purposes?
fields.EN:
Can you please satisfy
the Jail's Sleep once
for research purposes?

fields.JP:
ハーメルンのげぼくのメルヒェン達を
集めるための道具を探してほしいんだ。
旧河川・沼エリアにあったりしないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need a tool to gather
Hameln's minions. 
Maybe you'll find it at Waterside.
fields.EN:
I need a tool to gather
Hameln's minions. 
Maybe you'll find it at Waterside.

fields.JP:
私、今困ってるのよ～。
人助けと思って、アレ持ってきて～！
旧学生街エリアならきっとあるはずよん
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, I need ya to help!
You mind getting me the
thing at the Dorm?

旧河川・沼エリアで暴れている

旧寺院エリア４区に

そいつの死体を譲ってくれないか。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mind bringing me a
Marchen sample from
the Temple Area 4?
fields.EN:
Bring me the corpse of a fresh Marchen
from Temple Area 4.

旧寺院エリアで暴れている
デスマンティスを10体

旧寺院エリア３区に居座ってる

Can you get rid of the
Infecten at the
Temple Area 3?
fields.EN:
Can you get rid of the
Infect Hands at the
Temple Area 3?

fields.JP:
できればでいいんだけど、
ヘルメットをいくつか探してきてほしいの。
旧河川・沼エリアならありそうかも！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you bring me some
Helmets? There should
be some at Waterside.
fields.EN:
Can you bring me some
Helmets? There should
be some at Waterside.

fields.JP:
旧芸術通りエリアで暴れている

fields.LOCALIZED:

拠点開拓の資材が足りないんだ。
元芸術通りエリアのヒューマンキラー等から
鎧の断片を集めてきてください
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please gather Armor
Pieces from the enemies
at the Art Alley.
fields.EN:
Please gather Armor Fragments from Human Killers
and other enemies at the Art Alley.

fields.JP:
ちょっと作ろうと思ってる物があるだけど、
材料が足りないんだよね～。
旧芸術通りエリアならあるんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mind heading out
to the Art Alley to get
something for me?
fields.EN:
You mind heading out
to the Art Alley to get
something for me?

fields.JP:
ジェイルの食欲調査の為に

fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.EN:
Can you please satisfy

fields.JP:
最近、人がずいぶん増えて、
髪留めの在庫がなくなっちゃったのよ。
旧寺院エリアに代用品とかないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're running out of
hairpins. Can you check
the Temple for some?
fields.EN:
We're running out of
hairpins. Can you check
the Temple for some?

fields.JP:
頑強な防具を見繕ってくれ！
＋５以上の血式隊員服だ。
こんなところで死にたくねぇんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't wanna die!
I need a +5 Blood Gear,
please!
fields.EN:
I don't wanna die!
I need a +5 Blood Gear,
please!

fields.JP:
元繁華街エリアで暴れている
アサルトホースを12体

fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you go and hunt

Downtown?
fields.EN:
Can you go and hunt

fields.JP:
私的な事なのだが、探し物で困っていてな。
元繁華街エリアで見つかると思うのだが。
話だけでも聞いてくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you head Downtown
to get a certain something
for me?
fields.EN:
Can you head Downtown
to get a certain something
for me?

fields.JP:
元駅構内エリアのデッドリーチェア等から
白銀の鱗を集めてきてくれ。
高値で引き取ってやるぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm buying any Silver
Scales you find at the
Station Grounds.
fields.EN:
Please gather Silver Scales from Deadly Chairs
and other enemies at the Station Grounds.

fields.JP:
ジェイルの睡眠欲調査の為に
ジェイルの睡眠欲を2回

fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you please satisfy
the Jail's Sleep 2 times
for research purposes?
fields.EN:
Can you please satisfy

fields.JP:
花を探してきてほしいんだ。
もうどこにも咲いてないかもしれないが、
旧芸術通りエリアとか探してみてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mind heading to
the Art Alley to look for
some flowers for me?
fields.EN:
You mind heading to
the Art Alley to look for
some flowers for me?

fields.JP:
元繁華街エリア３区に居座ってる
プリンスカーストを
倒してきてくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you get rid of the
Cursed Prince at the
Downtown Area 3?
fields.EN:
Can you get rid of the
Cursed Prince at the
Downtown Area 3?

fields.JP:
砂糖大根って知ってる？
見つけたら取ってきてほしいの。
元駅構内エリアにないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you go to the
Station Grounds to get
some sugar beets?
fields.EN:
Can you go to the
Station Grounds to get
some sugar beets?

fields.JP:
元繁華街エリアで暴れている
キャッスルオウガを10体
討伐してきてくれ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you go and hunt
10 Castle Ogres at
Downtown?
fields.EN:
Can you go and hunt
10 Castle Ogres at
Downtown?

fields.JP:
元駅構内エリアで暴れている
ワイルドレオンを8体
討伐してきてくれ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you go and hunt
8 Wildleon at
the Station Grounds?
fields.EN:
Can you go and hunt
8 Wildleon at
the Station Grounds?

fields.JP:
元繁華街エリアにお母さんがくれた
カエルのぬいぐるみを
落としてきちゃったんだ…
fields.LOCALIZED:
I lost my frog plushie
that mom gave me
in Downtown...
fields.EN:
I lost my frog plushie
that mom gave me
in Downtown...

fields.JP:
拠点開拓の資材が足りないんだ。
元街道沿いエリアのモアモア等から
青い水晶体を集めてきてください
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please gather Blue
Crystals from the enemies
at the City Streets.
fields.EN:
Please gather Blue
Crystals from the enemies
at the City Streets.

fields.JP:
元駅構内エリア４区に居座ってる
イオンナーグを
倒してきてくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you get rid of the
Nargion at the Station
Grounds Area 4?
fields.EN:
Can you get rid of the
Nargion at the Station
Grounds Area 4?

fields.JP:
素材が足りなくて困ってるわ。
元墓所エリアのデストゥードゥ等から
緑の皮膜を集めてきてほしいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need some Green
Hides, so can you get
some from the Graveyard?
fields.EN:
Please gather Green Membranes from enemies
at the Graveyard.

fields.JP:
私の使ってたシャベルが壊れちゃって、
見つけたら持ってきて欲しいんだけど…
元街道沿いエリアにないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
My shovel broke, so can
you find me one at the
City Streets?
fields.EN:
My shovel broke, so can
you find me one at the
City Streets?

fields.JP:
元駅構内エリアで暴れている
グレイテストハウルを5体
討伐してきてくれ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you go and hunt
5 Titanic Howls at
the Station Grounds?
fields.EN:
Can you go and hunt
5 Greatest Howls at
the Station Grounds?

fields.JP:
元街道沿いエリアで暴れている
ノイジーキャットを10体
討伐してきてくれ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you go and hunt
10 Noisy Cats at
the City Streets?
fields.EN:
Can you go and hunt
10 Noisy Cats at
the City Streets?

fields.JP:
見つけたらでいいんだけど、
小さくて軽いダンベル持ってきてくれない？
元駅構内エリアにありそうじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mind looking for a
small weight? I saw one
at the Station Grounds.
fields.EN:
You mind looking for a
small weight? I saw one
at the Station Grounds.

fields.JP:
元街道沿いエリア５区に居座ってる
ラゴスレプスを
倒してきてくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you get rid of the
Lagosleps at the
City Streets Area 5?
fields.EN:
Can you get rid of the
Lagosleps at the
City Streets Area 5?

fields.JP:
元墓所エリアで暴れている
サーヴェルセクトを10体
倒してきてくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you go and hunt
10 Servillesects at
the Graveyard?
fields.EN:
Can you go and hunt
10 Servillesects at
the Graveyard?

fields.JP:
監獄塔８階に
生きの良いメルヒェンがいるはずだ。
そいつの死体を譲ってくれないか。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mind bringing me a
Marchen sample from
the Jail Tower Floor 8?
fields.EN:
You mind bringing me a
Marchen sample from
the Jail Tower Floor 8?

fields.JP:
監獄塔１階にいる
ヴィーナスリップを
倒して！夫の仇なのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Avenge my husband for me
by killing the Naked Ace
in Tower Base Floor 1!
fields.EN:
Avenge my husband for me
by killing the Venus Lip
in Jail Tower Floor 1!

fields.JP:
ジェイルの食欲調査の為に
ジェイルの食欲を15回
満たしてきてほしい。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you please satisfy
the Jail's Hunger 15 times
for research purposes?
fields.EN:
Can you please satisfy
the Jail's Hunger 15 times
for research purposes?

fields.JP:
ジェイルの性欲調査の為に
ジェイルの性欲を15回
満たしてきてほしい。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you please satisfy
the Jail's Libido 15 times
for research purposes?
fields.EN:
Can you please satisfy
the Jail's Libido 15 times
for research purposes?

fields.JP:
ジェイルの睡眠欲調査の為に
ジェイルの睡眠欲を3回
満たしてきてほしい。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you please satisfy
the Jail's Sleep 3 times
for research purposes?
fields.EN:
Can you please satisfy
the Jail's Sleep 3 times
for research purposes?

fields.JP:
メニューの『カスタム』では、
スキルの新規習得・強化・セットができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can learn, strengthen, and set Skills under the
Customize Skills menu.
fields.EN:
In the 'Custom' menu, you can learn,
strengthen, and set Skills.

fields.JP:
属性は『火、風、土、水』の4種類あり、
敵の弱点を突くと大ダメージを与えられます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are 4 elements - Fire, Air, Earth, and
Water - used to attack an enemy's weak point.
fields.EN:
There are 4 elements - Fire, Wind, Earth, and
Water - used to attack an enemy's weak point.

fields.JP:
装備品の強化や職業変更、ブラッドファームに
必要な『血晶』は、メルヒェンを倒すと手に入ります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Crystals are used to strengthen equipment, to
change jobs, and for the Blood Farm. They can be
obtained by defeating Marchens.
fields.EN:
Blood Crystals are used to strengthen equipment, to
change jobs, and for the Blood Farm. They can be
obtained by defeating Marchens.

fields.JP:
かごめかごめ効果はスキルや武器の「血走り属性」が
付いていると発生する可能性があります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Kagome-Kagome effect may take effect when
you use a Skill or weapon with a Bloodshot
modifier on them.
fields.EN:
The Kagome-Kagome effect may take effect when
you use a Skill or weapon with a Bloodshot
modifier on them.

fields.JP:
クリティカル予告は「コンボ」を
重ねることで発生しやすくなります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The more combos you do, the more likely a
Critical Notice will occur.
fields.EN:
The more combos you do, the more likely a
Critical Notice will occur.

fields.JP:
独房エリア移動中はＹボタンで短縮操作を
行う事ができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press the Y Button to easily move within the
prison areas.
fields.EN:
Press the Y Button to easily move within the
prison areas.

fields.JP:
敵の弱点を突くと『血しぶき』が発生し、
『返り血アイコン』が少しずつ満たされます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you attack an enemy's weak point, their blood
splatters, filling the Blood Splatter meter.
fields.EN:
If you attack an enemy's weak point, their blood
splatters, filling the Blood Splatter meter.

fields.JP:
『返り血アイコン』がＭＡＸまで溜まると、
強力な『ジェノサイドモード』に変身できます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
When the Blood Splatter meter is maxed, you can enter
Massacre mode.
fields.EN:
When the Blood Splatter meter is maxed, you can enter
Genocide mode.

fields.JP:
『オーバーキル』を発生させると、
血式少女全員が血しぶきを浴びるほか、
敵が血晶を必ずドロップします。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Overkilling will splatter blood on all Blood Maidens
and force Blood Crystals to drop.
fields.EN:
Overkilling will splatter blood on all Blood Maidens
and force Blood Crystals to drop.

fields.JP:
血式少女の返り血を『舐める』ことで、
癒し効果のある『魂血スキル』が発動します。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can activate a Blood Soul Skill by licking the
splattered blood on a Blood Maiden, which has healing
or buffing effects.
fields.EN:
You can activate a Blood Soul Skill by licking the
splattered blood on a Blood Maiden, which has healing
or buffing effects.

fields.JP:
メモにはヒントが書かれています。
メニューのアイテムから確認しましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Memos contain tips, which can be viewed through the
Item menu.
fields.EN:
Memos contain tips, which can be viewed through the
Item menu.

fields.JP:
スイッチなどで扉を開いた時、マップを見れば
どこの扉が開いたかわかります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can check your mini map to see which portals
are open and closed.
fields.EN:
After opening a door with a switch, check the map
to see which door opened.

fields.JP:
ナイトメア・ジャックの「意識メーター」が高まると、
暴走するジャックリッパーに変化します。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nightmare Jack will go on a rampage and turn into
Ripper Jack when his mind meter reaches its limit.
fields.EN:
Nightmare Jack will go on a rampage and turn into
Ripper Jack when his mind meter reaches its limit.

fields.JP:
ナイトメア・ジャックの意識メーターは『しんこきゅう』や
『カウンセリング』コマンドで鎮めることができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can calm Nightmare Jack's mind meter using
Deep Breath and Counseling.
fields.EN:
You can calm Nightmare Jack's mind meter using
Deep Breath and Counseling.

fields.JP:
ナイトメア・ジャックの「ナイトメアくうかん」では
一定の確率で敵の行動を縛ることができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nightmare Jack can use Nightmare Zone, which has
a chance of nullifying enemy actions.
fields.EN:
Nightmare Jack can use Nightmare Zone, which has
a chance of nullifying enemy actions.

fields.JP:
ナイトメア・ジャックは、戦闘中に３回暴走すると、
完全に理性を失い、ゲームオーバーになります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The game ends if Nightmare Jack goes on a rampage
3 times in battle.
fields.EN:
The game ends if Nightmare Jack goes on a rampage
3 times in battle.

fields.JP:
『虐殺鬼ごっこ』から逃れるためには、
ナイトメアをできるだけ引き離しましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
In order to escape a Chase, you will need to run
as far away as possible from the Nightmare.
fields.EN:
In order to escape a Chase, you will need to run
as far away as possible from the Nightmare.

fields.JP:
ナイトメアに追い詰められたら戦闘を挑み、
部位を破壊するか、ダメージを蓄積させノックダウンさせましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
If caught by a Nightmare, you will need to destroy a
part of its body during battle or damage it
enough to knock it down.
fields.EN:
If caught by a Nightmare, you will need to destroy a
part of its body during battle or damage it
enough to knock it down.

fields.JP:
ナイトメアの部位を破壊した上で逃げ切ると、
普段よりも良いアイテムを入手できます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you are able to run away after knocking the
Nightmare down, you can obtain better items than usual.
fields.EN:
If you are able to run away after knocking the
Nightmare down, you can obtain better items than usual.

fields.JP:
オプションでは色々な細かい設定ができるので、
一度覗いてみよう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can make various tweaks and adjustments
through the Options menu.
fields.EN:
You can make various tweaks and adjustments
through the Options menu.

fields.JP:
感染付き状態異常はターン開始時に
隣のキャラクターに状態異常が感染することがあります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ailments that are classified as Infections have a chance
of infecting adjacent characters with the ailment
at the beginning of each Turn.
fields.EN:
Ailments that are classified as Infections have a chance
of infecting adjacent characters with the ailment
at the beginning of each Turn.

fields.JP:
状態異常の猛毒は「毒」と
同じアイテムで打ち消すことができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can cure Heavy Poison using any means used
to cure Poison.
fields.EN:
You can cure Heavy Poison using any means used
to cure Poison.

fields.JP:
ジェイルの欲求を満たすと、
ジェイルボーナスが発生し恩恵が得られます。
fields.LOCALIZED: Fulfilling the Jail's desire will impart a Jail Bonus.
fields.EN: Fulfilling the Jail's desire will impart a Jail Bonus.

fields.JP:
オプションでジェイルボーナスの一連の操作を
自動化することができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can fully automate the Jail Bonus system
via Options.
fields.EN:
You can fully automate the Jail Bonus system
via Options.

fields.JP:
食欲を満たすには『血しぶきを発生させる』、
性欲は『エモーションポイントなどを調べる』、
睡眠欲は『ジェイル睡眠中にノーダメージ』。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Splatters satisfy Hunger. Finding Emotion
Points satisfies Libido. Winning battles without taking
damage (while the Jail is sleeping) satisfies Sleep.
fields.EN:
Blood Splatters satisfy Hunger. Finding Emotion
Points satisfies Libido. Winning battles without taking
damage (while the Jail is sleeping) satisfies Sleep.

fields.JP:
月アイコンと同じ色の欲求を満たすと、
普段よりゲージが多く溜まります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the desire that's the same color as the Moon icon is
fulfilled, the gauge fills faster than usual.
fields.EN:
If the desire that's the same color as the Moon icon is
fulfilled, the gauge fills faster than usual.

fields.JP:
ダンジョン探索中、ジェイルが気まぐれで
欲求ゲージを上昇させることがあります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
While in the dungeon, the Jail may randomly increase
the Desire gauge.
fields.EN:
While in the dungeon, the Jail may randomly increase
the Desire gauge.

fields.JP:
装備品は、血晶を使用して強化できます。
必要な血晶は、装備品によって異なります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Equipment can be strengthened using Blood Crystals. The
Blood Crystals required depends on the equipment.
fields.EN:
Equipment can be strengthened using Blood Crystals. The
Blood Crystals required depends on the equipment.

fields.JP:
研究室の『スキル枠拡張』で、
所持できるスキルの数を増やせます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can increase the number of Skill slots in the
Laboratory.
fields.EN:
You can increase the number of Skill slots in the
Laboratory.

fields.JP:
『職業変更』を行うことで、ステータスや
習得できるスキルが変化します。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Changing jobs will alter both the character's stats and
the Skills that can be learned.
fields.EN:
Changing jobs will alter both the character's stats and
the Skills that can be learned.

fields.JP:
『職業開放権利』は、キャラクターのレベルを
一定値上げることで取得できます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can gain Job Unlock Rights by increasing the
character's level.
fields.EN:
You can gain Job Unlock Rights by increasing the
character's level.

fields.JP:
独房エリアでＺＬボタンを押すと
ブラッドファームが起動できます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press the ZL Button in the prison areas to access
Blood Farm.
fields.EN:
Press the ZL Button in the prison areas to access
Blood Farm.

fields.JP:
ブラッドファームで植えた血花は「血袋」を
与えるとレアなものが生まれやすい。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Flowers are grown at Blood Farms,
and covering them with blood with Blood Toss
increases the odds of obtaining rare items.
fields.EN:
Blood Flowers planted at the Blood Farm are more
likely to yield rare items when given a Blood Bag.

fields.JP:
ユ血スキル、装備スキルは重ねて装備することで、
効果が強力になっていきます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Similar Blood Pack Skills and equipped Skills can
be combined, which increases the Skill's effect.
fields.EN:
Similar Blood Pack Skills and equipped Skills can
be combined, which increases the Skill's effect.

fields.JP:
全てのエリアは、地続きに繋がっています。
道を標した『看板』を見つけたら確認しましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
All areas are connected. If you find a sign, be sure to
check it out.
fields.EN:
All areas are connected. If you find a sign, be sure to
check it out.

fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルターやジャックリッパーを
抱きとめたことで被害を自分だけに向けることができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Using Embrace will make Ripper Jack and any
Blood Maidens in Blood Skelter attack the one
that used Embrace.
fields.EN:
Using Embrace will make Ripper Jack and any
Blood Maidens in Blood Skelter attack the one
that used Embrace.

fields.JP:
ジェイルの機嫌が悪くなっていくと、
敵が強くなっていきます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The enemies will become stronger as the
Jail's mood worsens.
fields.EN:
The enemies will become stronger as the
Jail's mood worsens.

fields.JP: 【ブラッドスケルターモード】

返り血アイコンが濁ったままＭＡＸになると、
『ブラッドスケルターモード』に変身し、
敵味方関係なく攻撃してしまいます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the Blood Splatter meter is maxed while muddled, you
can enter Blood Skelter mode, where the character will
attack enemy and ally.
fields.EN:
If the Blood Splatter meter is maxed while muddled, you
can enter Blood Skelter mode, where the character will
attack enemy and ally.

fields.JP:
つうの部屋の「格納庫」に入れてあるアイテムは、
クエストクリアやプレゼント交換にそのまま使えます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Items stored in Otsuu's room can be used directly
to clear orders or to give as gifts.
fields.EN:
Items stored in the storage in Tsuu's room can be
used directly to clear quests or exchange gifts.

fields.JP:
ライブラリでは、依頼や敵の詳細情報、
チュートリアルなどを確認できます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can view work orders, enemy data, tutorials,
and more in the Library.
fields.EN:
You can view work orders, enemy data, tutorials,
and more in the Library.

fields.JP:
ジェイルマネージでは『ジェイルピース』を使い、
ジェイルのルーレットをある程度定めることができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Jail Pieces in Jail Control to set the roulette
to your favor.
fields.EN:
In Jail Manage, use Jail Pieces to control
the Jail's roulette to a certain extent.

fields.JP:
「トライジェイル」で縛りを設定することで、
お金や経験値等が多く貰えます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jail Trial increases the difficulty, but in turn
rewards you with more Gold and EXP.
fields.EN:
Setting restrictions in TriJail rewards you with
more Gold, EXP, and other benefits.

fields.JP:
エンカウントアップ・ダウンアイテムは
重ね掛けすることで効果が上昇します。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Items and effects that affects the encounter rate
work cumulatively to further increase its effects.
fields.EN:
Items and effects that affects the encounter rate
work cumulatively to further increase its effects.

fields.JP:
『血式退化』すると、レベルが下がる代わりに
ＣＰやステータス上昇ボーナスが得られます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Devolution lowers your level in exchange for
gaining CP and stat boosts.
fields.EN:
Blood Devolution lowers your level in exchange for
gaining CP and stat boosts.

fields.JP:
インテリアを血式少女にプレゼントすると、
部屋に置かれているインテリアも変化します。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Giving an interior item to a Blood Maiden will change
the appearance of her room.
fields.EN:
Giving an interior item to a Blood Maiden will change
the appearance of her room.

fields.JP:
『コンビネーション』で設定した血式少女は、
戦闘中に回復や追撃でサポートしてくれます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Partner Blood Maidens will offer support in battle,
such as through attacking or by healing.
fields.EN:
Partner Blood Maidens will offer support in battle,
such as through attacking or by healing.

fields.JP:
各血式少女の固有の『キャラクタースキル』は、
ステータスで確認できます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each Blood Maiden's Character Skill can be viewed
through their stats.
fields.EN:
Each Blood Maiden's Character Skill can be viewed
through their stats.

fields.JP:
【バンブーウィーバー】は、
竹編みの物体を生成し穴にふさぐ能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Bamboo Weaver creates an orb that can fill
gaps and holes.
fields.EN:
Bamboo Weaver creates a bamboo-woven object
that can plug holes.

fields.JP:
【フローズンティアー】は、
氷の冷たさで炎を消すなどの能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Frozen Tear is able to douse flames and
freeze liquids.
fields.EN:
Frozen Tear can extinguish flames with
the cold of ice.

fields.JP:
【磁力ピッコロ】は、
遠くの物を引き寄せることができる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Magnetic Piccolo is used to draw things closer to the
party.
fields.EN:
The Magnetic Piccolo is used to draw things closer to the
party.

fields.JP:
【ブレッドポータル】は、
歩きでは行けない場所にワープする能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Bread Portal is used to warp to areas that can't be
reached on foot.
fields.EN:
The Bread Portal is used to warp to areas that can't be
reached on foot.

fields.JP:
【ヘアー】は、遠くの宝箱を開けたり、
何かをつかむ必要がある時に使える能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hair Flair is used to open treasure chests from a
distance, and to grab things out of reach.
fields.EN:
Hair! can open distant treasure chests
and grab things from afar.

fields.JP:
【タケプロテクター】は、１０秒間、
トラップのダメージを無効化できる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Bamboo Guard is used to nullify damage from traps
for 10 seconds.
fields.EN:
The Bamboo Guard is used to nullify damage from traps
for 10 seconds.

fields.JP:
【プチプリンセス】は、
特定のアイテムを小さくできる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Tiny Princess is used to scale the size of certain
items.
fields.EN:
The Tiny Princess is used to shrink certain
items.

fields.JP:
【ポイズンボム】は、特定の壁を壊したり
植物を腐らせたりできる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Poison Bomb is used to destroy walls and rot away
vegetation.
fields.EN:
The Poison Bomb is used to destroy walls and rot away
vegetation.

fields.JP:
【ローズアロー】は、遠くにあるスイッチを
衝撃で押したりできる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Rose Arrow is used to activate switches from a
distance.
fields.EN:
The Rose Arrow is used to activate switches from a
distance.

fields.JP:
【１２ダッシュ】は、１２秒間、
自分達の移動速度を上昇させる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Twelve Dash is used to speed your party's movement
in the dungeon for 12 seconds.
fields.EN:
The Twelve Dash is used to speed your party's movement
in the dungeon for 12 seconds.

fields.JP:
【ボディニッパー】は、
金網などを切ることができる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED: The Body Nipper is used to sever chains and objects.
fields.EN:
The Body Nipper is used to cut wire fences and similar
obstacles.

fields.JP:
【ラビットジャンプ】は、
遠くにジャンプができる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Rabbit Jump allows your party to jump
great distances.
fields.EN:
The Rabbit Jump allows your party to jump
great distances.

fields.JP:
救護室の穢れ浄化すると、『穢れ耐性』がアップするほか、
HPかSPの上限値にボーナスが付与されます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Purging at the Rescue Center will increase resistance
to Corruption, while also boosting HP and SP limits.
fields.EN:
Purging at the Rescue Center increases Corruption
resistance and grants a bonus to either max HP or max SP.

fields.JP:
『BONUS』のノベルでは、前作の前日譚を
読むことができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail is a living organism that possesses three
desires. It uses mimicry to control itself.
fields.EN:
The "BONUS" novel lets you read the prequel
to the previous game.

fields.JP:
『ジェイル』は三大欲求を持つ生命体で、
擬態により監獄全体を自らの体としています。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The moon's color changes depending on the Jail's
desire. White represents Hunger, blue represents
Sleep, and red represents Libido.
fields.EN:
The Jail is a living organism with three desires.
Through mimicry, it makes the entire prison its body.

fields.JP:
月の色はジェイルの欲求に応じて変化します。
白は食欲、青は睡眠欲、赤は性欲です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Destroying a core matures the Jail. It also makes it
possible for you to kill the Nightmare associated with
it.
fields.EN:
The moon's color changes with the Jail's desire.
White is Hunger, blue is Sleep, and red is Libido.

fields.JP:
核の破壊は、ジェイルの成長を促進させます。
さらに、ナイトメアの不死性を取り除きます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snark is said to have killed an investigation unit 15
years ago. The professor claims that Snark is the king
of the Nightmares.
fields.EN:
Destroying a core promotes the Jail's growth
and removes the Nightmare's immortality.

fields.JP:
独房探索を開始したが、
やはり一筋縄では
いかないようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems as if it won't be as
easy as expected to search the
cells.
fields.EN:
It seems as if it won't be as
easy as expected to search the
cells.

fields.JP:
ジェイルの壁を切ると、
中から物資が発見できた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found some supplies after
hacking off part of the wall.
fields.EN:
I found some supplies after
hacking off part of the wall.

fields.JP:
ホオノキの葉
ここがこのような形

ジェイルにある物質は、
鋭利な刃物で
切れるようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Objects within the Jail
can be severed with a
sharp enough blade.
fields.EN:
Objects within the Jail
can be severed with a
sharp enough blade.

fields.JP:
歩いていては、
どうしても扉が閉まってしまう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Walking seems to trigger the
shutoff of the portal.
fields.EN:
If I walk, the door always
closes before I can get through.

fields.JP:
扉の放電を止めるには、
供給源を断ち切るしか
ない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Need to stop whatever's
electrifying the portal...
fields.EN:
To stop the door's discharge,
I'll have to cut off its power
source.

fields.JP:
像が吐き出す火は、全ての
台に灯す必要があるようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The fire from the statue needs
to light up all the stands.
fields.EN:
The fire from the statue needs
to light up all the stands.

fields.JP:
植物を腐らせる毒があれば、
先に進めるのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only I had a poison that
could wither the plant...
fields.EN:
If only I had a poison that
could wither the plant...

fields.JP:
擬態はジェイルの基本的な特性の
一つだと考えられる。
その証拠に、ジェイルの壁面には………
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mimicry is a basic ability of
the Jail. The proof can be
seen on the walls...
fields.EN:
Mimicry is a basic ability of
the Jail. The proof can be
seen on the walls...

fields.JP:
遠くを狙える道具が
あれば先に進めそうなのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think I could move forward
if I just had something that
could shoot from a distance...
fields.EN:
I think I could move forward
if I just had something that
could shoot from a distance...

fields.JP:
火の上を通した物には、
一瞬にして火が点くようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anything that goes over the
fire will light up in an 
instant.
fields.EN:
Anything that goes over the
fire will light up in an 
instant.

fields.JP:
凶暴な植物には、
必ず対になる心臓が
あるようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Vicious plants have a heart
somewhere that can be 
targeted.
fields.EN:
Vicious plants have a heart
somewhere that can be 
targeted.

fields.JP:
射出した物の進行方向を
変える置物を発見した
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found an object that changes
the direction of whatever's
shot out of it.
fields.EN:
I found an object that changes
the direction of whatever's
shot out of it.

fields.JP:
小さな鍵穴に、
普通の鍵を挿す方法は
ないだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
There has to be a way
of getting the key through
this tiny keyhole...
fields.EN:
There has to be a way
of getting the key through
this tiny keyhole...

fields.JP:
小さな棒でもあれば、
壁の隙間を調べられそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I should be able to use a
small stick to check the space
between the walls.
fields.EN:
I should be able to use a
small stick to check the space
between the walls.

fields.JP:
素早く通り抜けることで、
足元が崩れずに済んだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Running through helped me get
across safely.
fields.EN:
Running through helped me get
across safely.

fields.JP:
血をつけることで、
文字が浮き上がる壁を
発見した
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found walls that speak when
blood is splattered on them.
fields.EN:
I found a wall where writing
appears when blood is put on it.

fields.JP:
封印の札も
火にはかなわないようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems the seal tags can't
withstand fire.
fields.EN:
It seems the seal tags can't
withstand fire.

fields.JP:
お母さんの持たせてくれる
携帯食料は、保温が考えられ
有難いが、口煩いのは………
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate Mother packing me
warm rations. If only she didn't
nag so much...
fields.EN:
I appreciate Mother packing me
warm rations. If only she didn't
nag so much...

fields.JP:
高い所まで手が届かない。
何か長いものさえあれば
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't reach that high... I
need something to get up
there...
fields.EN:
I can't reach that high. If only
I had something long...

fields.JP:
孤児院の中に、
不思議なことを話す少女が
いるという。………
fields.LOCALIZED:
There was an unusual girl at
the orphanage. When I met her,
she spoke about the 'sun'.
fields.EN:
They say there's a girl in the
orphanage who says strange
things...

fields.JP:
遠くの物を取るために、
長く伸ばせる何かが
必要だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need something I can extend
to grab something out of my
reach...
fields.EN:
I need something I can extend
to grab something out of my
reach...

fields.JP:
分厚い防壁さえあれば、
さまざまな罠が防げるだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
A thick, protective wall
should help guard against the
various traps here.
fields.EN:
A thick, protective wall
should help guard against the
various traps here.

fields.JP:
向こう岸に渡りたいが、
飛び越えるのは難しそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to get across the
water, but it's too far to
jump...
fields.EN:
I want to get to the other side,
but it looks too far to jump.

fields.JP:
走れば、
プロペラの強風に
あおられずに済むだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Running should help against
the strong gust of the
propeller.
fields.EN:
Running should help against
the strong gust of the
propeller.

fields.JP:
プロペラの動作は、
スイッチで切り替えられるようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems as if I can the
propeller on and off using a
switch.
fields.EN:
It seems the propeller can be
toggled with a switch.

fields.JP:
床に付いている目。
どこを見つめているのだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
An eye on the floor... I
wonder what it's looking at.
fields.EN:
An eye on the floor... I
wonder what it's looking at.

fields.JP:
スイッチで可視化できる、
透明の床を発見した
fields.LOCALIZED:
Suddenly a switch came on, and
I could see everything!
fields.EN:
I found an invisible floor that
can be made visible with a
switch.

fields.JP:
巨大な像を見つけた。
像の目には、特別な力を
感じた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I discovered a giant statue.
There seemed to be odd power
emanating from its eyes.
fields.EN:
I discovered a giant statue.
There seemed to be odd power
emanating from its eyes.

fields.JP:
金属の塊が道をふさいでいる。
塊を動かす力さえあれば
fields.LOCALIZED:
A huge mass of metal is
blocking the way. If only I
had something to move it with.
fields.EN:
A huge mass of metal is
blocking the way. If only I
had something to move it with.

fields.JP:
ここにある口の中で、
音色に反応して開くものがある
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it hears something it 
likes, it will want to sing
along...
fields.EN:
Among the mouths here, some
seem to open in response to
certain tones.

fields.JP: 大きなハート型の石板
大きなハート型の石板
小さくなったハート型の石板
小さくなったハート型の石板
巨人像から取り出した目玉
fields.LOCALIZED:
An eyeball taken from the
giant statue.
fields.EN:
An eyeball taken from the

fields.JP:
メニューの『スキルカスタム』では、
スキルの新規習得・強化・セットができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can learn, strengthen, and set Skills under the
Customize Skills menu.
fields.EN:
You can learn, strengthen, and set Skills under the
Customize Skills menu.

fields.JP:
属性は『火、風、土、水』の4種類あり、
敵の弱点を突くと大ダメージを与えられます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are 4 elements - Fire, Air, Earth, and
Water - used to attack an enemy's weak point.
fields.EN:
There are 4 elements - Fire, Wind, Earth, and
Water - used to attack an enemy's weak point.

fields.JP:
各血式少女の固有の『キャラクタースキル』は、
ステータスで確認できます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each Blood Maiden's Character Skill can be viewed
through their stats.
fields.EN:
Each Blood Maiden's Character Skill can be viewed
through their stats.

fields.JP:
ジャックは、戦闘中に何度も気絶すると、
戦闘不能になり行動できなくなります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack will be KO'd if he continues to Stun himself in
battle repeatedly.
fields.EN:
Jack will be KO'd if he becomes Stunned repeatedly in
battle.

fields.JP:
ライブラリでは、依頼や敵の詳細情報、
チュートリアルなどを確認できます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can view work orders, enemy data, tutorials,
and more in the Library.
fields.EN:
You can view work orders, enemy data, tutorials,
and more in the Library.

fields.JP:
装備品の強化や職業変更に必要な『血晶』は、
メルヒェンを倒すと手に入ります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Crystals are used to strengthen equipment and to
change jobs. They can be obtained by defeating 
Marchens.
fields.EN:
Blood Crystals are used to strengthen equipment and to
change jobs. They can be obtained by defeating 
Marchens.

fields.JP:
敵の弱点を突くと『血しぶき』が発生し、
『返り血アイコン』が少しずつ満たされます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you attack an enemy's weak point, their blood
splatters, filling the Blood Splatter meter.
fields.EN:
If you attack an enemy's weak point, their blood
splatters, filling the Blood Splatter meter.

fields.JP:
『返り血アイコン』がＭＡＸまで溜まると、
強力な『ジェノサイドモード』に変身できます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
When the Blood Splatter meter is maxed, you can enter
Massacre mode.
fields.EN:
When the Blood Splatter meter is maxed, you can enter
Genocide mode.

fields.JP:
『オーバーキル』を発生させると、
血式少女全員が血しぶきを浴びるほか、
敵が血晶を必ずドロップします。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Overkilling will splatter blood on all Blood Maidens
and force Blood Crystals to drop.
fields.EN:
Overkilling will splatter blood on all Blood Maidens
and force Blood Crystals to drop.

fields.JP:
血式少女の返り血を『舐める』ことで、
癒し効果のある『魂血スキル』が発動します。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can activate a Blood Soul Skill by licking the
splattered blood on a Blood Maiden, which has healing
or buffing effects.
fields.EN:
You can activate a Blood Soul Skill by licking the
splattered blood on a Blood Maiden, which has healing
or buffing effects.

fields.JP:
『虐殺鬼ごっこ』から逃れるためには、
ナイトメアをできるだけ引き離しましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
In order to escape a Chase, you will need to run
as far away as possible from the Nightmare.
fields.EN:
In order to escape a Chase, you will need to run
as far away as possible from the Nightmare.

fields.JP:
ナイトメアに追い詰められたら戦闘を挑み、
部位を破壊してノックダウンさせましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
If caught by a Nightmare, you will need to destroy a
part of its body during battle to knock it down.
fields.EN:
If caught by a Nightmare, you will need to destroy a
part of its body during battle to knock it down.

fields.JP:
ナイトメアの部位を破壊した上で逃げ切ると、
普段よりも良いアイテムを入手できます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you are able to run away after knocking the
Nightmare down, you can obtain better items than usual.
fields.EN:
If you are able to run away after knocking the
Nightmare down, you can obtain better items than usual.

fields.JP: 【ブラッドスケルターモード】

返り血アイコンが濁ったままＭＡＸになると、
『ブラッドスケルターモード』に変身し、
敵味方関係なく攻撃してしまいます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the Blood Splatter meter is maxed while muddled, you
can enter Blood Skelter mode, where the character will
attack enemies and allies.
fields.EN:
If the Blood Splatter meter is maxed while muddled, you
can enter Blood Skelter mode, where the character will
attack enemies and allies.

fields.JP:
メモにはヒントが書かれています。
メニューのアイテムから確認しましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Memos contain tips, which can be viewed through the
Items menu.
fields.EN:
Memos contain tips, which can be viewed through the
Items menu.

fields.JP:
ジェイルの欲求を満たすと、
ジェイルボーナスが発生し恩恵が得られます。
fields.LOCALIZED: Fulfilling the Jail's desire will impart a Jail Bonus.
fields.EN: Fulfilling the Jail's desire will impart a Jail Bonus.

fields.JP:
食欲を満たすには『血しぶきを発生させる』、
性欲は『エモーションポイントなどを調べる』、
睡眠欲は『ジェイル睡眠中にノーダメージ』。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Splatters satisfy Hunger. Finding Emotion
Points satisfies Libido. Winning battles without taking
damage (while the Jail is sleeping) satisfies Sleep.
fields.EN:
Blood Splatters satisfy Hunger. Finding Emotion
Points satisfies Libido. Winning battles without taking
damage (while the Jail is sleeping) satisfies Sleep.

fields.JP:
月アイコンと同じ色の欲求を満たすと、
普段よりゲージが多く溜まります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the desire that's the same color as the Moon icon is
fulfilled, the gauge fills faster than usual.
fields.EN:
If the desire that's the same color as the Moon icon is
fulfilled, the gauge fills faster than usual.

fields.JP:
装備品は、血晶を使用して強化できます。
必要な血晶は、装備品によって異なります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Equipment can be strengthened using Blood Crystals. The
Blood Crystals required depends on the equipment.
fields.EN:
Equipment can be strengthened using Blood Crystals. The
Blood Crystals required depends on the equipment.

fields.JP:
ダンジョン探索中、ジェイルが気まぐれで
欲求ゲージを上昇させることがあります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
While in the dungeon, the Jail may randomly increase
the Desire gauge.
fields.EN:
While in the dungeon, the Jail may randomly increase
the Desire gauge.

fields.JP:
ジェイルの欲求を満たすと、ジェイルが成長して、
ダンジョンのフロアが増えることがあります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A new area may be unlocked when the Jail
matures after having its desires fulfilled.
fields.EN:
A new area may be unlocked when the Jail
matures after having its desires fulfilled.

fields.JP:
アイテムが所持数の限界に達したら、
ジャックの部屋の『格納庫』に預けましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you have too many items, you can keep them in
Storage inside Jack's room.
fields.EN:
If you have too many items, you can keep them in
Storage inside Jack's room.

fields.JP:
全てのエリアは、地続きに繋がっています。
道を標した『看板』を見つけたら確認しましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
All areas are connected. If you find a sign, be sure to
check it out.
fields.EN:
All areas are connected. If you find a sign, be sure to
check it out.

fields.JP:
ジャックの血液残量は、戦闘中の
『造血』コマンドで増やすことができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's Blood can be increased in battle using the
Create Blood command.
fields.EN:
Jack's Blood can be increased in battle using the
Create Blood command.

fields.JP:
研究室の『スキル枠拡張』で、
所持できるスキルの数を増やせます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can increase the number of Skill slots in the
Laboratory.
fields.EN:
You can increase the number of Skill slots in the
Laboratory.

fields.JP:
『職業変更』を行うことで、ステータスや
習得できるスキルが変化します。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Changing jobs will alter both the character's stats and
the Skills that can be learned.
fields.EN:
Changing jobs will alter both the character's stats and
the Skills that can be learned.

fields.JP:
『職業権利』は、キャラクターのレベルを
一定値上げることで取得できます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can gain Job Rights by leveling the character to a
certain level.
fields.EN:
You can gain Job Rights by leveling the character to a
certain level.

fields.JP:
『血式退化』すると、レベルが下がる代わりに
ＣＰやステータス上昇ボーナスが得られます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Devolution lowers your level in exchange for
gaining CP and stat boosts.
fields.EN:
Blood Devolution lowers your level in exchange for
gaining CP and stat boosts.

fields.JP:
インテリアを血式少女にプレゼントすると、
部屋に置かれているインテリアも変化します。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Giving an interior item to a Blood Maiden will change
the appearance of her room.
fields.EN:
Giving an interior item to a Blood Maiden will change
the appearance of her room.

fields.JP:
『コンビネーション』で設定した血式少女は、
戦闘中に回復や追撃でサポートしてくれます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Partner Blood Maidens will offer support in battle,
such as through attacking or by healing.
fields.EN:
Partner Blood Maidens will offer support in battle,
such as through attacking or by healing.

fields.JP:
【ワンダーホール】は、セーブや
ダンジョンからの脱出ができる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Rabbit Hole is used to create saves and to escape
from dungeons.
fields.EN:
The Wonder Hole is used to create saves and to escape
from dungeons.

fields.JP:
【ボディニッパー】は、
金網などを切ることができる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED: The Body Nipper is used to sever chains and objects.
fields.EN:
The Body Nipper is used to cut wire fences and similar
obstacles.

fields.JP:
【ポイズンボム】は、特定の壁を壊したり
植物を腐らせたりできる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Poison Bomb is used to destroy walls and rot away
vegetation.
fields.EN:
The Poison Bomb is used to destroy walls and rot away
vegetation.

fields.JP:
【ローズアロー】は、遠くにあるスイッチを
衝撃で押したりできる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Rose Arrow is used to activate switches from a
distance.
fields.EN:
The Rose Arrow is used to activate switches from a
distance.

fields.JP:
【プチプリンセス】は、
特定のアイテムを小さくできる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Tiny Princess is used to scale the size of certain
items.
fields.EN:
The Tiny Princess is used to shrink certain
items.

fields.JP:
【１２ダッシュ】は、１２秒間、
自分達の移動速度を上昇させる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Twelve Dash is used to speed your party's movement
in the dungeon for 12 seconds.
fields.EN:
The Twelve Dash is used to speed your party's movement
in the dungeon for 12 seconds.

fields.JP:
【タケプロテクター】は、１０秒間、
トラップのダメージを無効化できる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Bamboo Guard is used to nullify damage from traps
for 10 seconds.
fields.EN:
The Bamboo Guard is used to nullify damage from traps
for 10 seconds.

fields.JP:
【ブレッドポータル】は、
歩きでは行けない場所にワープする能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Bread Portal is used to warp to areas that can't be
reached on foot.
fields.EN:
The Bread Portal is used to warp to areas that can't be
reached on foot.

fields.JP:
【ヘアー！】は、遠くの宝箱を開けたり、
何かをつかむ必要がある時に使える能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hair Flair is used to open treasure chests from a
distance, and to grab things out of reach.
fields.EN:
Hair! is used to open treasure chests from a
distance, and to grab things out of reach.

fields.JP:
【磁力ピッコロ】は、
遠くの物を引き寄せることができる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Magnetic Piccolo is used to draw things closer
to the party.
fields.EN:
The Magnetic Piccolo is used to draw things closer
to the party.

fields.JP:
浄化すると、『穢れ耐性』がアップするほか、
HPかSPの上限値にボーナスが付与されます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Purging will increase resistance to Corruption, while
also boosting HP and SP limits.
fields.EN:
Purging increases Corruption resistance and grants a
bonus to either max HP or max SP.

fields.JP:
『ノベルの切れ端』を手に入れると、タイトルの
『BONUS』で小説版の序章が見られます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Collect Novel Pages to read a prologue through the
BONUS menu on the title screen.
fields.EN:
Collect Novel Pages to read a prologue through the
BONUS menu on the title screen.

fields.JP:
『ジェイル』は三大欲求を持つ生命体で、
擬態により監獄全体を自らの体としています。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail is a living organism that possesses three
desires. It uses mimicry to control itself.
fields.EN:
The Jail is a living organism with three desires.
Through mimicry, it makes the entire prison its body.

fields.JP:
月の色はジェイルの欲求に応じて変化します。
白は食欲、青は睡眠欲、赤は性欲です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The moon's color changes depending on the Jail's
desire. White represents Hunger, blue represents
Sleep, and red represents Libido.
fields.EN:
The moon's color changes depending on the Jail's
desire. White represents Hunger, blue represents
Sleep, and red represents Libido.

fields.JP:
核の破壊は、ジェイルの成長を促進させます。
さらに、ナイトメアの不死性を取り除きます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Destroying a core matures the Jail. It also makes it
possible for you to kill the Nightmare associated with
it.
fields.EN:
Destroying a core matures the Jail. It also makes it
possible for you to kill the Nightmare associated with
it.

fields.JP:
黎明は、核を壊すことで『監獄塔』を伸ばし、
地上への脱出を目指しています。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Dawn is an organization that seeks to escape the
Jail by destroying cores in an effort to grow the Jail
Tower and reach the surface.
fields.EN:
The Dawn is an organization that seeks to escape the
Jail by destroying cores in an effort to grow the Jail
Tower and reach the surface.

fields.JP:
１５年前に調査隊を惨殺した『スナーク』。
ナイトメア達の王だと博士は語ります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snark is said to have killed an investigation unit 15
years ago. The professor claims that Snark is the king
of the Nightmares.
fields.EN:
Snark is said to have killed an investigation unit 15
years ago. The professor claims that Snark is the king
of the Nightmares.
